mapper.sql: s.id, s.name, s.alias, s.note, s.avatar_path, s.use_count, s.sort, s.hidden, s.created_at, (select count(distinct vs.video_id) from media_video_studio vs where vs.studio_id = s.id) as video_count
mapper.select: select from media_studio s order by s.sort asc, s.name asc, s.id asc
select from media_studio s where s.hidden = 0 order by s.sort asc, s.name asc, s.id asc
select from media_studio s where s.name = #{name} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into media_studio (name, alias, note, avatar_path, use_count, sort, hidden) values (#{name}, #{alias}, #{note}, #{avatarPath}, 0, coalesce(#{sort}, 0), coalesce(#{hidden}, 0))
mapper.update: update media_studio set name = #{name}, alias = #{alias}, note = #{note}, avatar_path = #{avatarPath}, sort = coalesce(#{sort}, 0), hidden = coalesce(#{hidden}, 0) where id = #{id}
update media_studio s set s.use_count = (select count(*) from media_video_studio vs where vs.studio_id = s.id) where s.id in #{studioId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from media_video where id = #{videoId}
select count(distinct video_id) from media_video_studio where studio_id = #{studioId}
select s.id as id, s.name as name, s.alias as alias from media_video_studio vs inner join media_studio s on s.id = vs.studio_id where vs.video_id = #{videoId} order by s.name asc, s.id asc
select studio_id from media_video_studio where video_id = #{videoId}
mapper.insert: insert ignore into media_video_studio (video_id, studio_id) select #{videoId}, s.id from media_studio s where s.id = #{studioId}
mapper.select: select v.id as id, v.title as title, v.folder as folder, v.rel_path as rel, v.size as size, v.dur as dur, v.w as w, v.h as h, v.poster_path as poster from media_video v where v.hidden = 0 and exists (select 1 from media_video_studio vs where vs.video_id = v.id and vs.studio_id = #{studioId}) order by v.folder asc, v.title asc, v.id asc limit #{offset}, #{size}
select count(*) from media_video v where v.hidden = 0 and exists (select 1 from media_video_studio vs where vs.video_id = v.id and vs.studio_id = #{studioId})
select vs.video_id as videoId, s.name as name from media_video_studio vs inner join media_studio s on s.id = vs.studio_id where s.hidden = 0 order by vs.video_id asc, s.name asc
select s.name from media_video_studio vs inner join media_studio s on s.id = vs.studio_id where vs.video_id = #{videoId} and s.hidden = 0 order by s.name asc
